name: Jesus
note: The risen Lord whose story Luke's Gospel tells.

name: Simon Peter
note: A fisherman, the leader of the apostles in the early chapters.

name: John
note: An apostle and a fisherman, with Peter at the temple.

name: The eleven
note: The apostles after Judas' death.

name: The twelve
note: The apostles, with Matthias.

name: The apostles
note: The twelve, sent by Jesus.

name: Mary
note: The mother of Jesus.

name: Jesus' brothers
note: They did not believe in him earlier but are among the believers now.

name: Judas Iscariot
note: The apostle who betrayed Jesus.

name: Matthias
note: Chosen to take Judas' place.

name: Two men in white
note: They appear at the ascension.

name: The believers
note: The first followers of Jesus in Jerusalem.

name: The pilgrims
note: Jews from many nations in Jerusalem for Pentecost.

name: The lame man
note: Healed at the Beautiful Gate.

name: The crowds
note: Ordinary people in Jerusalem.

name: Annas
note: A former high priest, still very influential.

name: Caiaphas
note: High priest from about AD 18 to 36.

name: The Sadducees
note: A priestly party that denied resurrection.

name: The council
note: The Sanhedrin.

name: Barnabas
note: A Levite from Cyprus, named Joseph, nicknamed "Son of Encouragement."

name: Ananias and Sapphira
note: A husband and wife who lied about a gift.

name: The high priest
note: The head of the temple and the council.

name: Gamaliel
note: A respected Pharisee and teacher of the law.

name: The Hellenist widows
note: Greek-speaking widows who were neglected.

name: Stephen
note: One of the seven; the first martyr.

name: Philip
note: One of the seven, later called the evangelist.

name: Nicolaus
note: A proselyte of Antioch, one of the seven.

name: The Synagogue of the Freedmen
note: A group of Jews from North Africa and Asia Minor who argued with Stephen.

name: Saul
note: A young man from Tarsus who approves of Stephen's death; later called Paul.

name: Simon the magician
note: A Samaritan magician who believed and then tried to buy the Spirit.

name: The Samaritans
note: People of Samaria, long divided from the Jews.

name: The Ethiopian eunuch
note: A treasurer of the queen of the Ethiopians.

name: Candace
note: The title of the Ethiopian queen.

name: Ananias of Damascus
note: A disciple sent to Saul.

name: The Hellenists
note: Greek-speaking Jews in Jerusalem.

name: Aeneas
note: A paralyzed man at Lydda.

name: Tabitha (Dorcas)
note: A disciple in Joppa, full of good works.

name: Simon the tanner
note: Peter's host in Joppa.

name: Cornelius
note: A centurion of the Italian Cohort in Caesarea.

name: The angel
note: Appeared to Cornelius at the ninth hour.

name: The brothers from Joppa
note: Six believers who go with Peter.

name: Cornelius' household
note: Relatives and close friends.

name: The circumcised believers
note: Jewish believers who were with Peter or in Jerusalem.

name: The scattered believers
note: Men of Cyprus and Cyrene who preached at Antioch.

name: Agabus
note: A prophet from Jerusalem.

name: The disciples at Antioch
note: The church first called Christians.

name: Claudius
note: Roman emperor from AD 41 to 54.

name: Herod Agrippa I
note: King over Judea from AD 41 to 44; grandson of Herod the Great.

name: James
note: Brother of John and one of the twelve; killed by Herod.

name: The angel of the Lord
note: Frees Peter and strikes Herod.

name: The praying church
note: Gathered in Mary's house.

name: Mary, mother of John Mark
note: Her house is a meeting place.

name: Rhoda
note: A servant girl at Mary's house.

name: James, the brother of Jesus
note: Leader of the Jerusalem church.

name: The delegation from Tyre and Sidon
note: They depend on Herod's territory for food.

name: John Mark
note: Barnabas' cousin; goes with Paul and Barnabas.

name: Paul
note: Also called Saul; a Pharisee from Tarsus, the apostle to the Gentiles.

name: Simeon called Niger
note: A prophet and teacher at Antioch.

name: Lucius of Cyrene
note: A prophet and teacher at Antioch.

name: Manaen
note: Raised with Herod Antipas.

name: Elymas (Bar-Jesus)
note: A Jewish magician in Paphos.

name: Sergius Paulus
note: The Roman proconsul of Cyprus.

name: The synagogue rulers
note: They invite Paul to speak.

name: The Gentiles of Pisidian Antioch
note: They glorify the word of the Lord.

name: The Jews of Pisidian Antioch
note: Some stir up persecution.

name: The lame man at Lystra
note: Lame from birth.

name: The crowds at Lystra
note: They take Paul and Barnabas for gods.

name: The priest of Zeus
note: At the temple in front of the city.

name: Jews from Antioch and Iconium
note: They stone Paul.

name: The disciples at Lystra
note: They stand around Paul after the stoning.

name: The elders
note: Leaders appointed in each church.
